scripts.lint: pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py && pnpm lint:go && pnpm lint:jvm && pnpm lint:swift && pnpm lint:ruby
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/rust/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:py: uvx ruff check packages/python && uvx ruff format --check packages/python
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/rust/Cargo.toml && uvx ruff format packages/python && gofmt -w packages/go && gradle -p packages spotlessApply && swift format --in-place -r packages/swift/Sources && (cd packages/ruby && rubocop -A)
